description: This Java source file defines the MusicService class, which manages music playback in an Android application. It handles media playback, media session integration, notifications, playlist management, and playback controls.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: Android Service class managing music playback, notifications, and media session controls.

classes.name: MusicService.LocalBinder
classes.description: Binder class providing clients with access to the MusicService instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes media session and creates notification channel.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for Android Oreo and above.

methods.name: setPlaylist
methods.description: Sets the playlist and starting index, then begins playback.

methods.name: playSong
methods.description: Prepares and starts playing the current song, updates media session and notification.

methods.name: updateMediaSession
methods.description: Updates media session metadata and playback state.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Builds and updates the media playback notification with controls.

methods.name: createActionIntent
methods.description: Creates PendingIntent for media control actions.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles playback control intents (play/pause, next, previous).

methods.name: playPause
methods.description: Toggles playback state between play and pause.

methods.name: playNext
methods.description: Plays the next song in playlist, shuffling if enabled.

methods.name: playPrevious
methods.description: Plays the previous song in playlist.

methods.name: getAudioSessionId
methods.description: Returns audio session ID for equalizer or audio effects.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases MediaPlayer and media session resources.
